title: Decide Minthara's Fate
html:
Decide Minthara's Fate is a quest available upon entering Moonrise Towers in Act Two, provided  Minthara survived the previous act. Specifically, this quest is available in Act Two if the party side with Minthara during the ⁠Raid the Emerald Grove or if they knocked her out or proceeded without defeating her.

Successful completion unlocks Minthara as a possible companion. If Minthara dies at any point during this quest, it completes and she cannot be revived.

Objectives

Objectives and journal entries may vary pending story decisions and outcomes.

Check on Minthara.
  • "Nightwarden Minthara has been condemned to death. We ought to visit her while we can."
(Optional) Defeat the jailers.
  • "We've drawn the ire of Minthara's guards. We need to defeat them before we can aid her."
(Optional) Talk to Minthara.
  • "We defeated Minthara's guards. We should talk to her."
Bring Minthara outside Moonrise Towers.
  • "Minthara has asked for our help escaping Moonrise Towers. We'll have to escort her until we've put some distance between us and the forces of the Absolute stationed here."
Quest Complete
  • [Minthara escaped, joined camp] "We helped Minthara escape Moonrise Towers. She went to our camp to recover from her ordeal."
  • [Minthara escaped, left] "We helped Minthara escape Moonrise Towers. She's elected to go her own way."
  • [Minthara died] "Minthara did not escape her fate at Moonrise, and she never will."
  • [Minthara's mind was erased] "Minthara's captors erased her free will completely. She is an obedient thrall, loyal to the Absolute, and without a personality of her own."

Walkthrough

“
I want to be clear - letting Minthara tag along with us was your idea. So if you wake up with a dagger to your throat, that's on you.
„
— Astarion, speaking to the player character after Minthara is recruited

Reunions

If Minthara survives Act One, the party encounter her in Moonrise Towers, where she is judged by  Ketheric Thorm and  Disciple Z'rell. Regardless of success or failure with any checks, Minthara is ultimately taken away to have her mind erased unless the party intervene.

Fighting to free Minthara

If the party attack when she is being taken downstairs, all inhabitants of Moonrise turn hostile, starting a tough fight. Minthara must then be escorted out, although she fights with the party as an ally. Using skill checks to talk the way out peacefully is then not possible anymore and ⁠Infiltrate Moonrise Towers cannot be completed.

Avoiding the fight and speaking to the Inquisitors

If the party decline to fight, Minthara is moved downstairs to Moonrise Towers Prison, where the Deep Gnomes  Sumera and  Jasin start to break and, ultimately, erase her mind. They can be allowed to do so, which brings the quest to an early end. Otherwise, the gnomes can be convinced to let the player character take over:

[1]
  • [DECEPTION] I've been instructed to handle this prisoner myself. (DC 10)
  • [INTIMIDATION] Stand aside. I'm taking charge here. (DC 14)

Talking to Minthara

If the player character successfully steps in and takes over, Minthara is initially unable to speak as she battles the Absolute, which is working to break her mind. Passing a  DC 18 Wisdom Check allows communication with her:

[1]
  • [WISDOM] Push past the presence, towards Minthara. (DC 18 ) (if Minthara was satisfied with the player during the camp celebration)
  • [WISDOM] Push past the presence, towards Minthara. (DC 18 ) (if Minthara was annoyed with the player during the camp celebration)
  • [WISDOM] Push past the presence, towards Minthara. (DC 18)
  • Acknowledge the presence - ask it to let you pass. (if the party encountered the Absolute in the cracked wall)
  • Push past the presence, towards the drow. (if the party encountered the Absolute in the cracked wall)

The player character can then attempt to free her:

[1]
  • Questioner Jasin
    Is it done? I did not feel her mind break.
    • [INTIMIDATION] Because I reshaped her. If it is breaking your desire, I can snap you like a twig. (DC 18)
    • [DECEPTION] She is cleansed, as ordered. Were my methods too subtle for you? (DC 18)
    • [PERSUASION] Look at her. The True Soul Minthara you knew is gone. (DC 18)
    • Attack the guards.

Successfully passing one of the ability checks convinces Sumera and Jasin to leave. A failure of any check leads to either fighting against the inquisitors or allowing Minthara's mind to be erased.

The  Dark Urge gains the inspiration ⁠Soulful Lobotomy if they personally erase Minthara's mind.

Attacking the Inquisitors

If the party attack Sumera and Jasin, Minthara assists in the fight as an ally of the party. After both are defeated, she asks to be escorted out of Moonrise Towers.

Escaping

If freed, regardless of the method used, Minthara must be escorted out of Moonrise Towers. It is not possible to go to camp or use a waypoint to obtain her freedom; the party and Minthara must leave on foot.

If released from Sumera and Jasin's inquisition, Minthara becomes an Attached Follower to the player character; she cannot be equipped with gear, but can be controlled with her (unarmed) attacks and spells. However, if she picks up a weapon from the ground, she automatically equips it and thus can use it in combat.

If no fight broke out before, then it is possible to walk out with Minthara peacefully. This requires a selection of ability checks with:

Adept Ghulen, just outside Minthara's cell:

[2]
  • [ILLITHID] [WISDOM] She's with me - stand down. (DC 14)
  • [TRUE SOUL] What prisoner?
  • [INTIMIDATION] Minthara's been released - and that frees up a cell for people like you, who challenge their betters. (DC 14)
  • [PERSUASION] I think she serves rather well as my personal servant, don't you? (DC 14)
  • [DECEPTION] Just look at her. You've nothing to fear from this drooling idiot. (DC 16)
  • Attack.

Zealot Malik and Zealot Merim, at the entrance of Moonrise Towers:

[3]
  • [PERSUASION] She's completely loyal to me. I'll keep her in line. (DC 14)
  • [INTIMIDATION] She goes where I take her - get out of my way. (DC 14)
  • [DECEPTION] She's entirely repurposed, and has no will of her own. (DC 14)

Alternatively, the party can try to avoid these encounters, such as with  Stealth or by casting  Invisibility on Minthara. One possible path is heading north-east from the docks and then crossing the broken section of the pathway by using  Jump.

If the prison guards are already dead but the Ironhand gnomes have not been freed yet, completing ⁠Rescue Wulbren and escaping by boat offers an escape route.

Afterwards

Once Minthara leaves the boundaries of Moonrise Towers, she can be spoken with and either told to go her own way or head to camp where she can finally be recruited as Companion.[4]

Quest rewards

  • Aside from loot and combat XP, only successfully escorting Minthara out offers the following rewards.
  • If Minthara was given the camp's location
    • 145 XP
    •  Minthara as a companion
    • The following inspirations are gained for freeing and recruiting Minthara on wrap up:
      • ⁠Nobleborn as Below, so Above ( Noble background)
      • ⁠Twice Scorned, Twice Abandoned ( Urchin background)
  • If Minthara escaped but went her own way
    • 65 XP

Notes

  1. ↑ 1.0 1.1 1.2 Dialogue file: Act2/MoonriseTowers/MOO_MintharaFate_Torture
  2. ↑ Dialogue file: Act2/MoonriseTowers/MOO_NGB_MintharaFate_SpottedWithMinthara
  3. ↑ Dialogue file: Act2/MoonriseTowers/MOO_MintharaFate_Checkpoint
  4. ↑ Be aware that if Minthara is recruited as a companion and returns to Moonrise Towers while Ketheric Thorm is still alive, and she is not near the player character or another tadpole-infected companion, she will be (whether disguised or not) attacked if seen by tower guards or other principal followers of the Absolute. If other party members are nearby, they may be drawn into the conflict as well. The exact range required to avoid a fight is not yet known, but if avoiding a fight is desired, it is recommended that companion Minthara remain within sight of a tadpole-infected party member while in Moonrise Towers.
